description: Create a Thalovant runtime group — the unit that hosts hubs and holds installed skills. Requires the hubs:write scope and a paid plan. Unlike the hub write routes this one takes no etag.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

cloneFromDefault.description: Seed the new group from the workspace default group instead of starting empty.

environment.description: 1-32 characters. Lowercased server-side; defaults from server settings.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

ownerId.description: Defaults to the caller. Setting another owner requires admin.

name: thalovant_create_runtime_group
title: Create Runtime Group
